name: Appfigures
description: App intelligence for product discovery, store metadata, current and historical rankings, and modeled download and revenue estimates across the App Store and other supported stores.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: Personal Access Token
credential_fields.description: Appfigures Personal Access Token created for an API Client. Enable public:read and the Public Data API/App Intelligence access required by the tools you plan to use.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List country codes and metadata supported by Appfigures.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Appfigures store category IDs, devices, and supported subcharts such as free, paid, and topgrossing. Use these IDs with rank snapshots.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Appfigures products by app or developer name. Competitor/public products require the Public Data API add-on and public:read scope.

term.description: Product or developer search term; prefix with @name= or @developer= for field-specific search.

storefronts.description: Semicolon-separated storefront slugs, for example apple;google_play.

meta.description: Include extended metadata; consumes additional credits.

tools.name: get_product_by_store_id
tools.description: Resolve an app from its native store ID, such as an Apple numeric app ID or Google Play package name, and return its Appfigures product ID and metadata.

store_id.description: Native store identifier: Apple app ID, Google package name, or equivalent.

meta.description: Include extended metadata and categories; consumes additional credits.

tools.name: get_rank_snapshot
tools.description: Get a current or recent full ranking snapshot for a country, Appfigures category ID, and free, paid, or topgrossing subchart. Requires the Public Data API add-on.

time.description: Use current or a timestamp from the last 24 hours in yyyy-MM-ddTHH format.

tools.name: get_rank_history
tools.description: Get hourly or daily rank history for one or more Appfigures product IDs. Competitor apps require the Public Data API add-on.

countries.description: Country codes separated as accepted by Appfigures.

filter.description: Only include ranks within the top N.

tools.name: get_download_revenue_estimates
tools.description: Get proprietary estimated downloads and net app-store revenue for selected products and countries. This endpoint is available only on eligible App Intelligence plans/licenses.

start_date.description: yyyy-MM-dd or a relative value such as -30.

end_date.description: yyyy-MM-dd or a supported relative value.

group_by.description: Comma-separated pivots from product, country, date, store.
